MNU_parameters.lfHeight: Declared widget raw+0x1BB minus1; default declaration16 if zero.
MNU_parameters.shadow_enabled: flags+0x1BC bit1; foreground+0x1C2, shadow+0x1C6 are COLORREF.
MNU_parameters.glyph_advance: DBCS characters use declared fontsize; ASCII group layout uses exported glyph.char_width (GetCharWidthA, excludes charExtra1). TextOut ink still uses glyph.advance. A nonterminal group adds 2+(declared fontsize>>1).
MNU_parameters.coordinates: Widget rect (raw+0x29..0x35) plus menu origin, not draw_point_raw.
